product_brief: A public blockchain protocol executing the first post-quantum transaction on mainnet using Falcon signatures.
pqc_capability_description: Algorand has executed the first post-quantum transaction on its mainnet using NIST-selected Falcon signatures. The ledger is already quantum-secure due to Falcon-1024 signatures for state proofs. Production-grade Falcon implementation with deterministic signing mode and constant-time coding practices is shipped. Tooling supports key generation, address derivation, and transaction signing via Logic Signatures.
crypto_primitives: Falcon (Falcon-512, Falcon-1024), Ed25519, RSA (mentioned as broken by quantum algorithms)
key_management_model: Programmatic key management via CLI; keys derived from 24-word mnemonic, random entropy, or deterministic seed; addresses derived from compiled logic signatures; off-curve address derivation to separate from classical accounts.
primary_platforms: Algorand Virtual Machine (AVM), TEAL, Command-line interface (CLI)
pqc_roadmap_details: Falcon is currently experimental for securing accounts and consensus layer; consensus upgrade remains a separate workstream. Falcon is already used in production for state proofs.
consensus_mechanism: Not stated (mentions "consensus vote" and "committee selection" but does not name the specific consensus algorithm like Pure PoS)
implementation_attack_surface: Implementation uses double-precision floating-point operations with deterministic rounding to avoid subtle security issues; constant-time coding practices used to reduce timing side channels; deterministic signing with fixed salt version prevents nonce reuse issues and provides provable misbehavior evidence.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Uses Logic Signatures to embed Falcon public keys in stateless smart contracts; allows users to fund and interact with them like any other account; complete developer workflow provided via CLI.

product_brief: A cross-signer protocol enabling Ethereum-compatible wallets to use quantum-safe signatures via NIST-recommended PQC algorithms.
pqc_capability_description: QAN XLINK is a quantum-safe cross-signer protocol that enables integration of Ethereum-compatible wallets with quantum-safe signature-capable keypairs. It utilizes NIST’s primary-recommended lattice-based Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithm (ML-DSA, FIPS 204). The protocol has passed a full cybersecurity audit by Hacken, validating its defenses against future quantum-based attacks. It provides a migration path for the post-quantum era.
primary_platforms: Desktop (QAN XLINK desktop app), Ethereum-compatible wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet)
pqc_roadmap_details: Utilizes NIST’s primary-recommended lattice-based PQC algorithm (ML-DSA, FIPS 204). Developers can apply to test the QAN XLINK desktop app.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Seamless integration with existing Ethereum-compatible wallets; 100%-guaranteed safe migration path.

product_brief: Post-quantum Bitcoin fork implementing BIP 360 and Dilithium signatures for quantum-resistant transactions.
pqc_capability_description: Implements BIP 360 (Pay-to-Merkle-Root) to eliminate key-path spend vulnerabilities. Uses NIST-standardized ML-DSA (Dilithium) signatures. Includes five Dilithium post-quantum signature opcodes in P2MR tapscript context. Provides end-to-end CLI wallet tooling and RPC support for creating, signing, and spending P2MR transactions on testnet.
target_industries: Cryptocurrency, Finance, Telecommunications, Logistics, Life Sciences, Defense
pqc_roadmap_details: BTQ expects to operate a Bitcoin Quantum mining pool. Projects accumulation of approximately 100,000 BTQ tokens in the first 12 months. Building future monetization pathways across security-as-a-service, premium settlement infrastructure, and quantum certification.
testing_&_validation_methods: Live testnet environment with 50+ miners and 100,000+ blocks mined. Functional validation across address creation, funding, transaction construction, signing, mempool acceptance, broadcast, and confirmation.
financial_&_business_impact: Mining pool fee of 3% on block rewards. Projected accumulation of 100,000 BTQ tokens in first 12 months.
